channel.title: Pier & Point · P11
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P11 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P11: The P11 median strip's map shape cited no sources. It now lists the OCII 2023 transition presentation, the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map, the OCII Nov 2024 CAC update and SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 deck. The record said OCII's 2023 presentation lists 'P11/11A' as already managed by Rec & Park; the deck says Rec & Park 'will manage' them, so the wording now follows it, and the physical description is labelled as resting on Pier & Point's own tracing. The identification of the strip as P11 is unchanged but flagged: OCII's 2024 update and Rec & Park's Workshop 3 timeline ('P11 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2015)') group P11 with the Commons, so what P11 covers remains an open question. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the citation to Pier & Point's own mapping notes is labelled as such.
